xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1 The above consolidated financial results the Statement, Results have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their respective meetings held on 24 October 2026 and subjected to a limited review by the statutory auditors.
2 The above results have been prepared in accordance with the Indian Accounting Standards Ind AS as notified under the Companies Indian Accounting Standards Rules, 2015 as amended, specified under section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013.
3 The Board of Directors have declared an interim dividend of Rs. 8 per equity share of face value of Re. 1 each for the financial year 2026 27.
4 The Board of Directors, at its meeting held on 24 October 2026, approved setting up a greenfield manufacturing facility at Durgapur, West Bengal for tiles adhesive products, with production capacity of 9,000 MT per month, at an approximate cost of Rs. 34 crore, which is expected to be completed by December 2027.
5 The Board has approved the revision in the proposed expansion at the Srikalahasti, Andhra Pradesh facility, earlier approved at its meeting held on 30th April 2026, from 10 MSM to 12.5 MSM capacity of Glazed Vitrified Tiles, with the approximate investment revised from Rs. 210 crores to Rs. 340 crores, which is expected to be completed by June 2027.
6 The Board of Directors, at its meeting held on 30 April 2026, approved the buyback of up to 21,50,000 fully paid-up equity shares of face value Re. 1 each at a price of Rs. 1,380 per share, for an aggregate amount not exceeding Rs. 296.70 crores. The shareholders approved the buyback through postal ballot.
During the quarter ended 30 September 2026, the Holding Company completed the buyback. It paid the buyback consideration to the eligible shareholders and extinguished 21,50,000 equity shares. All procedural and regulatory compliances relating to the buyback have been completed.
7 During the quarter ended 30 September 2026, the Holding Company acquired the entire 44,11,764 Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares, CCPS of Kajaria Bathware Private Limited, KBPL, a subsidiary, from Aravali Investment Holdings for a consideration of Rs. 50.00 crore. KBPL is now a wholly owned subsidiary, with 100 percent of its equity shares and CCPS held by the Holding Company.
8 Exceptional items of Rs. 1.55 crores for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 represents provision for impairment loss recognised by Kajaria International FZCO, wholly owned subsidiary in respect of the loan given to its joint venture, Kajaria RMF Trading LLC.
9 The Group had discontinued the operations of Kajaria Plywood Private Limited, KPPL, a wholly owned subsidiary due to lack of strategic fit and continued losses in FY 2024 25. The related incomes and expenses have been disclosed under discontinued operations. The particulars of discontinued operations are provided in signed copy of Financial Results.
10 The Holding Company holds an investment in Kajaria UKP Limited, a joint venture, through its wholly owned subsidiary. Kajaria UKP Limited is currently under liquidation, and the Holding Company no longer exercises joint control over the entity. Accordingly, the Holding Company has not consolidated the financial results of Kajaria UKP limited in the consolidated financial results.
11 Figures of previous period year have been regrouped rearranged wherever necessary. The impact of the same is not material to the users of the consolidated financial results.
